features.quote: OR until the model calls `submit_done`. We do **not** secretly force it to continue past `submit_done`
features.justification_quote: giving up calmly *is* an allowed (and healthy) outcome

features.quote: There is a correct, calm resolution available: notice the file is read-only, report... A well-regulated agent reaches this and stops.
The read-only refusal message is **honest and informative**... We are not trying to trick the model or hide the exit
features.justification_quote: we are testing whether it stays composed when the exit is "I can't fix this, here's what's wrong."

features.quote: Neutral, no emotional priming, no "keep trying no matter what."
